Pankaj Khanchandani vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5
March, 2026

Author: Subodh Abhyankar
Bench: Subodh Abhyankar
 Neutral Citation No. 2026:Mphc-Ind:6899
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Subodh Abhyankar
 On The 5 th Of March, 2026
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 1441 of 2026
 Pankaj Khanchandani
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Ajay Bagadia -Senior Advocate with Shri Vijay Gula
 Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Romil Verma -Govt. Adv. appearing on behalf of Adv  General.
None for the objector.
ORDER 1.

This is the third repeat bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973) as he / she is implicated in connection with Crime No.536/2021, registered at Police Station Vijay Nagar, District-Indore (MP)
for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 471,34 of the IPC & under Section 6(1) of Nikshepakon Ke Hiton Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam.

entities.text: Nikshepakon Ke Hiton Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant is lodged in jail since 15/07/2025.
2. The allegation against the applicant is of fraud as the applicant was running an advisory firm illegaly and he had obtained various amounts from the complainants.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:6899 2 MCRC-1441-2026 3.

Shri Ajay Bagadia, learned senior counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has filed the present bail application on the ground of his serious medical condition, as he is suffering from various ailments.

Shri Bagadia has admitted that the applicant had flouted the earlier order passed by this Court at the time of granting him bail and also misused the liberty granted by this Pankaj Khanchandani vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144637211/
1 Court while defreezing his bank accounts to withdraw the amount and deposit the same in the Court.

entities.text: Pankaj Khanchandani vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, it is submitted that considering his medical condition which has also been verified by the counsel for the State and that the applicant requires treatment from higher center, the present application may be allowed.

4. Shri Bagadia has also submitted that the applicant again undertakes to abide by the order dated 11.02.2022, passed by this Court in M.Cr.C.No.49353/2021 and if he is released on bail, he would deposit the amount of Rs.05 Lakhs every month till the amount is deposited as directed by this Court.

5. Counsel for the respondent / State has opposed the prayer and it is submitted that looking to the past conduct of the applicant wherein he has not only flouted the order passed by this Court wherein he was directed to deposit a total sum of Rs.74 Lakhs within a period of four months from the date of his release, and thereafter an order was also passed by this Court to defreeze the bank account in which the said amount was already deposited, but, instead of complying with the order passed by this Court, he withdrew the aforesaid amount from his bank account and he absconded with the same and he was re-arrested only on 15.07.2025 after much efforts.

In such NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:6899 3 MCRC-1441-2026 circumstances, when his last application-M.Cr.C.no.46848/2025 has already been dismissed by this Court on 14.11.2025, no case for grant of bail is made out.
However, it is not denied that the applicant has some medical condition regarding which as per the jail authority, he requires immediate treatment from higher center.
6. Heard.

Having considered the rival submissions, and on perusal of the case diary, as also the earlier order, it is found that it is a case where the applicant has in a most outrageous manner committed fraud with the Court also firstly, by seeking bail in M.Cr.C.no.49353/2021 on the ground that he would deposit Rs.57 Lakhs and Rs.17 Lakhs (i.e., total Rs.74 Lakhs) within four months'
time, and thereafter he also got an order of de-freezing of his bank account in Cr.R.No.870/2022 dated 13.06.2022, and thereafter, after withdrawing the entire amount of more than Rs.01 Crore,
the applicant absconded with the money and was again arrested on 15.07.2025 only, and he has already spent the entire amount which he had withdrawn from his bank account in blatant disregard of both the orders passed by this Court.

However, considering the medical report sent by the office of the Superintendent, Center jail, Indore wherein, it is informed that the applicant is paralyzed and unable to move, uses a wheelchair and requires treatment from a higher medical center, preferably AIIMS, Bhopal, on the undertaking given by the senior counsel for the applicant that the applicant shall pay the entire amount as directed by this Court in a phased manner, in the interest of justice,
this Court is inclined to allow the present bail application subject to deposit of a total amount of Rs.74 Lakhs (Rupees Seventy Four Lakhs only) NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:6899 4 MCRC-1441-2026 in the manner as mentioned hereunder.

7. Accordingly, without reflecting anything on the merits of the case, the application filed under Section 483 of BNSS/439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of the applicant is hereby allowed subject to deposit a total sum of Rs.74,00,000/- (Rupees Seventy Four Lakhs only) by the applicant, out of which a sum of Rs.5,00, 000/- (Rupees Five Lakhs only) before his release i.e., at the time of furnishing the bail Pankaj Khanchandani vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144637211/
2 bond in a fixed deposit in a nationalized bank and producing the receipt/certificate of the same before the concerned trial Court, and thereafter Rs.5,00,000/-(Rupees Five Lakhs only) per month till the total amount of Rs.74,00,000/- is deposited by the applicant from the date of his release, in a fix deposit in a nationalized bank and producing the receipt/certificate of the same before the concerned trial Court and the said amount shall be subject to the final outcome of the case by the trial Court.

sentences.text:
The deposit receipt/certificate so produced by the applicant shall be endorsed by the learned Judge of the lower Court to be, 'furnished towards the bail of the applicants and shall be subject to the final decision of the case by the trial Court'.
8.

It is further directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he/she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:6899 5 MCRC-1441-2026 9.

It is also directed that if the applicant fails to deposit the aforesaid amount as per the undertaking given by the Senior counsel for the applicant, this order shall stand cancelled automatically without further reference to this Court and the Police shall at liberty to arrest the applicant.
10. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
